items.text: Slithering Snails
???, Practice Room

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Everything alright?

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: *hiss* Ah, no. Not really, my leg's still painful. I probably overdid it when I was stretching.

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: No excuses. Charlotte, I'm giving you five more minutes to warm up.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: Five minutes ...

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: If you want, I can send you off on a permanent break.
A smirk appears on the young girl's face. She can hold her feelings back no longer.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: I followed the choreography to the letter.

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Why? If you'd done that, we wouldn't be having this discussion right now, would we?

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Come on then, Charlotte, speak up. What is it? Cat got your tongue, or what?

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Your pathetic pride?

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: I—

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: I don't want to hear any excuses.
She waves her hand impatiently.

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Again! Don't let me think you're a failure now, Charlotte.
She turns on the wire recorder, and the music pierces Charlotte's eardrums.
The young Floor Ritualist takes a deep breath. When she lifts her head, a smile is plastered on her face.
The music plays on.

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Raise your hand!
She grabs her wrist and lifts it higher.

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Kick! With range, I say!
She points her toes as she extends her leg to capacity.

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Good.
An objective and fair assessment.
She feels a bit relaxed and proceeds to the next move—the most crucial step of any Floor Ritual routine.
The performer must integrate their understanding of arcanum into their performance, unifying body, mind, emotion, and arcane skill.
For competitors, this is also the most challenging part.

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Wrong! Where's your arcane skill?!

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Stop! Stop!
She turns off the wire recorder, bringing the practice to an immediate halt. She casts an ice-cold glare in the girl's direction.

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: You forgot the routine again, Charlotte.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: I didn't ...

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Really now? Then why didn't you connect the elements? Why would you hesitate at the most important part of the whole bloody thing?! This element is worth at least 1.2 points!

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Do you understand what that means? 1.2 points could be the difference between first and fourth!
She lets out a deep sigh.

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: You're a failure, Charlotte. I can't tell you how disappointed I am in you.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: But everything else up to then was perfect! My last coach told me my movements were the most standard she'd seen.
The coach sneers.

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: So where are you going to find those 1.2 points you just lost? In your old coach's mouth? You listen to me now, girlie, the competition rules don't bend to accommodate little girls who can't use their arcane skills.

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Don't get cocky, Charlotte. I've seen my fair share of Floor Ritualists in my time, and your arcane skills are by far the least impressive.

items.speaker: Coach
items.text: Think about it. You need to have a long, hard think about what happened here today.
She murmurs this, as if she's almost speaking to herself, then sighs and leaves the training room.

items.speaker: Charlotte
items.text: I'm not a failure!
Willow's House
A terrible nightmare. She grits her teeth in the dim light of her bedroom.
The clock on the wall inches toward 7 o'clock. It's almost time for her appointment. She slides her legs off the edge of the bed and attaches her prosthetic limb.
Her stump is always slightly swollen due to the constant and prolonged pressure of her artificial appendage. As she moves, its creaking echoes through the otherwise silent room.
*ring-ring-ring*

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: Bloody hell. Just perfect timing ...
She hastily fastens the leather strap of her prosthetic leg. As she stands, her poor fastening comes loose, causing her to fall heavily to the ground.
Ms. Willow! I heard a loud bang just now. Have you taken a tumble?
A young voice echoes from the other side of the door.
Ms. Willow, could you open the door for me? One of the snails is about to crawl up my hand!

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: Oh, have a feckin' laugh, why don't you?!
She hops over to the door and opens it with a sullen expression on her face. Her prosthetic is left lying on the floor.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Here you go, Ms. Willow! Your snails for the week.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: You alright?

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: Mind your own business, will you? Give me the snails.
Flutterpage blinks, then holds the jar of snails up to Willow.

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: Hurry on to the letterbox and pick up your reward for the week.

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Could you give me a different reward this week, Ms. Willow?

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: What?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: I'm thinking ... For my reward, could you tell me what you do at home all day?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Thompson says there are strange noises coming from this house every day, like a hundred frogs croakin' at the same time. Is that your arcane skill? Why's your arcane skill like that?

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: Ms. Willow, can you tell me how-how I can—

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: Get out of my garden!

items.speaker: Flutterpage
items.text: But ...

items.speaker: Willow
items.text: Did you hear me? I said:
GET OUT OF HERE!
Before she even finishes her exclamation, she has already slammed the door shut.
